nom: SKIN1004 Lab in Nature Centella Retinol 0.2 Boosting Shot Ampoule

avis.titre: Jury is Still Out on Efficacy
avis.texte: I'll begin by noting that my skin can be somewhat sensitive, but not overly. When I apply this to bare skin I actually feel a quick tingle, but not in a painful way, more of an "oooh there is actually some kind of active ingredient in this formula" way. Overall I can not say I've seen any difference in my skin tone or texture, but due to sensitivity issues, I've only been using this a couple times a week. My only qualm with this product really comes down to the package - it should be in a dark bottle to keep out the light and the dropper could work a bit better. All in all, I will keep using this product and update my review if I start to see a change.
I had to use this a few weeks to see how it worked - overall I'm pretty happy with the noticeable results 🖤
This serum is really good for your skin. When you just start using the serum and don't want have reaction to aggressive treatment. Texture 10 of the 10

I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review. I've been using this product for two weeks now, and I'm really happy with the results. The texture is smooth, easy to spread, and absorbs quickly without leaving any sticky residue. I felt a mild tingling sensation upon application, but it was very manageable. After two weeks of consistent use, my skin feels noticeably smoother, and my dark spots have visibly faded. Definitely worth a try!

I actually really liked this. It wasn't harsh like some other retinols and I could see a difference with consistent use. My one big issue is the container. It is somewhat difficult to get out with the dropper and I had to kind of smack it against the counter a few times. Otherwise, I liked the consistency of the serum.

avis.titre: Good retinol that doesn't make skin itchy
avis.texte: It doesn't make my skin itch at all, and it doesn't dry out my skin. It's easy to apply because it has a dropper to add to your skin, and it has a light pleasant smell. My skin feels smoother after using this product.

I've been using the Nature Centella Retinol 0.2 Boosting Serum, and I really like how it feels on my skin. It's gentle, absorbs quickly, layers well with other products, and leaves my skin feeling soft and smooth without irritation. I haven't noticed any visible changes or major results yet, but it's a great option if you're looking for a mild retinol that's comfortable to use.
Have been using for about 3 weeks so not a super long time but have no reaction/breaking out or dryness from this. It's very moisturizing and I'll continue to use this up!

As someone who has gradually incorporated retinol into my skincare routine, I was excited to try this ampoule. First, I have to mention how much I love the packaging. The bottle is delicate, simple, and beautifully designed while still feeling elevated. The dropper top makes application easy and allows you to dispense the right amount of product without any mess.The formula has a silky, slightly cushiony texture that spreads easily and absorbs well without leaving my skin feeling greasy or heavy. I did notice a subtle tingling sensation when applying, but it was mild and faded quickly. My skin feels smooth, hydrated, and soft after use. This ampoule has worked really well in my current skincare routine. Since it contains retinol, I've been using it every other night to slowly build up my skin's tolerance and allow my skin time to adjust. With consistent use, my skin feels smoother and looks more refined overall. If you're newer to retinol, I definitely recommend easing into it and following with a good moisturizer and daily sunscreen. Overall, this is a thoughtfully formulated retinol ampoule that combines effective ingredients with a beautiful design, making it an enjoyable addition to my nighttime skincare routine.

I've been using this retinol serum for a few weeks and have definitely noticed smoother skin and a more even texture. It absorbs well and doesn't feel heavy or greasy, which I really like. That said, it is pretty strong—my skin felt a bit dry and slightly irritated at first, so I'd recommend starting slow and using it a few times a week before building up.

avis.titre: Light retinol , great layering with other products
avis.texte: The ampoule has a lightweight texture that absorbs quickly without leaving a greasy or sticky feeling. It layers well with other skincare products and feels comfortable for evening use. The combination of centella and retinol helps leave the skin feeling smoother and more hydrated over time. The formula feels gentle compared to some stronger retinol products, although beginners may still want to start with a few applications per week. The pump dispenses a good amount of product without creating waste. With consistent use, the skin appears more even and refined, while the centella helps keep irritation to a minimum.

I have sensitive skin so I am usually wary of retinol products but this product is so good. I started off using it for a few times a week and so far so good. I love how it leaves my skin feeling. It is definitely a great addition to my skin care routine.

I am actually realy enjoying this retinol product. I feel as if I am starting to see some skin improvements in my face! I have noticed that these little fine lines I was having around the bottom of my cheeks are starting to dissapear! My skin looks overall more supple and tight. My skin has taken to this product really well, no irritation has occured. I use about every other night or at least 2 times a week. The dropper doesnt hold much, but really you don't need a lot. A little goes a long way and I try to concentrate on my problem areas mostly. The scent is nice as well. Price point is very fair and affordable for a good retionol product! I would continue to purchase!
Very gentle on the skin. Leaves my skin radiating. After a few weeeks of use I noticed brighter less dull skin. I added it to my anti-aging regimen

Retinol is usually used to help increase skin cell turnover to get a better skin texture and provide anti-aging benefits and this product exactly just does that. It has 0.2% of retinol along with Centella, sqalane, and retinal. It's mild not too strong and worked perfectly on my skin because I did not notice any breakouts or peeling thus far. I just applied it after washing my face and cleansing it and putting a pea size amount all over my face starting with once a week. I really appreciate that using it I did not have any skin irritation at all, and I used it together with sunscreen for the best results.
I received a free sample to review this product. I am so happy with this! I've used multiple different retinals and this product leaves my skin smooth and feeling much tighter.

This product was super easy to incorporate into my skincare routine. It has both 0.2% retinol serum paired with centella, which gave me results while keeping my skin calm. I experienced no stinging at all, just a tiny, almost non-existent tingle that reassured me it was actively working. The serum has a great consistency and is thick enough to apply directly onto my face without running down before I can rub it in. I definitely recommend this, especially for those who are looking for a retinol with more mindful ingredients.

I LOVE this product! When you first apply, there is a slight tingling/burning sensation that only lasts a few seconds. It has a very pleasant light scent to it as well which makes using it a nice experience. I apply other serums and a moisturizer over the top and then my nighttime skincare routine is complete and my face feels fresh, clean and moisturized when I go to bed.

avis.titre: I like the product, bottle makes it hard
avis.texte: It does not take much serum to coat the face, and it does seem to work fairly well with hydrating face. However its very hard to get much out of the full bottle. Only tiny drips at at time, I think i would have enjoyed more if it wasnt so faulty to use

avis.titre: My Skin Has Never Looked Better!
avis.texte: I've been using the Nature Centella Retinol 0.2 Boosting serum and I'm honestly impressed! It leaves my skin feeling smoother, softer, and looking more radiant. The formula is gentle thanks to the centella, so it doesn't leave my skin feeling overly dry or irritated like some retinol products can. I've also noticed my skin texture has improved and my complexion looks more even. It absorbs quickly, layers well with the rest of my skincare routine, and a little goes a long way. I highly recommend it to anyone looking for an effective yet gentle retinol product!

Thank you to Skin1004 for giving this to me for free in exchange for my honest review. I wanna start by saying I was quite intimidated by trying this. I've tried spicules before and thought they were quite intense. So because this is paired with retinol I was extra cautious. However, I didn't feel any intense pain or even much tingling. I was completely surprised and that made me way more comfortable to keep using this. I don't have deep lines so my results might be less impressive but I do notice less fine lines. Keep in mind to only use this on dry skin, wet skin might make this too tingly and may cause irritation. I think it's also important to mention that you should be using skin barrier strengthening products if you are in a drier climate. It's definitely worth it for the results!
Smooths rough patches, fades post-acne dark marks, and minimizes the look of pores. I'm loving it so far

I have been using this consistently for a month. I am quite surprised it two major things. 1. The pores around my nose seem smaller. Its not significant but you cant totally see a difference especially when I put makeup on and 2. The fine lines under my eyes dont seem so prominent. Seeing this type of difference after a month is pretty significant usually it takes months to see a huge difference. I love the feeling of this ampoule. Its not wicked thick or gooey and it settles into your face pretty quick. I will also say that the only thing that is a con for me is the dropper. Now, mine might be broken but it doesn't work on sucking up any of the product. It's fine though I get it out either way.
If this is not incorporated into your daily skincare regimen that it needs to be it's a lovely booster it'll make you feel beautiful

avis.titre: So happy I got to try this!
avis.texte: I am so happy I was able to try this! It was gifted to me in exchange for my honest review. I have been wanting to not only try out this brand, but also this specific product for a while now. So I was super excited when I found out I was chosen for it. I absolutely love this serum! I deal with hormonal adult acne, which if you know can not be fully cured or even managed with just skincare products. You need hormonal replacement therapy. To my surprise, this serum actually did wonders for my poor and inflamed skin. I've been using it daily for the last 3 weeks about, and I've yet to deal with any burning or sensitivity to it, and it really did calm and reduce any current breakouts I've been dealing with. It layers nicely with other products and I don't ever deal with any pilling either. I can't wait to try other products from this brand. *Chef's kiss* 💋

Excellent product, this retinol is amazing. I have melanin in my face due to the sun exposure. I have used it for a month and it is good, it has cleared the spots a lot. It just needs to be use carefully and not too much quantity. Overall, totally recommend!

avis.titre: I don't think I would purchase this product
avis.texte: Lab in Nature sent me a free sample of the Centella Retinol 0.2 Boosting Shot Ampoule 30ml through the BzzAgent sampling program. I have been using this product for about 3 weeks. It does have a slight tingly feel when you first put it on. It goes away after a few moments. While it feels good on my skin, I can't say that I see a huge difference since using it. The dropper is curved and can make getting the product out of the bottle a bit difficult. I found that tilting the bottle just a bit seemed to help. The product is fine, I can't tell a difference in the way my skin looks or feels after using it for a few weeks, so I wouldn't purchase the product. I will continue using the product and update my review if anything changes.

avis.titre: Wow this really made a difference
avis.texte: I love how Lab In Nature Centella Retinol Boosting Shot Ampoule soaks right in. It leaves no film or cast. I put it on and then go right into whatever other product I'm using with out having to wait. It dries instantly. It's making a difference in my skin. I received this product for free in exchange for writing a review.

avis.titre: Lightweight texture, feels great on skin
avis.texte: I've tried this ampoule a few times so far. The texture is light and absorbs into the skin quickly, it doesn't feel greasy or sticky at all, which I really appreciate in a serum/ampoule. After applying, my skin feels noticeably soft and hydrated, almost like a light cushion of moisture without any heavy residue. It layers well under other products too. It's still early for me to comment on the long-term effects (like anti-aging benefits from the retinol), but based on the initial feel and how my skin responds right after application, my first impression is very positive.

I was really excited to try the Lab in Nature Centella Retinol serum, but unfortunately it was a letdown in several ways. First, the packaging is a major design flaw. Retinol is sensitive to light, so it should be packaged in a dark or opaque bottle to help preserve its stability and effectiveness. Instead, the clear bottle makes me question how well the product maintains its potency over time. The dropper is also poorly designed. It doesn't pick up the serum well, making it frustrating and difficult to get the product out of the bottle. I found myself having to repeatedly squeeze the dropper or tilt the bottle just to get enough product for one application. As for the formula itself, it tends to pill badly, especially when layering with other skincare products or moisturizer. Even after allowing it time to absorb, it often rolled off my skin instead of blending in smoothly. To make matters worse, I didn't notice any meaningful improvement in my skin after consistent use. Instead, I experienced irritation and redness without seeing the benefits I expect from a retinol product. Between the ineffective packaging, the pilling, and the lack of results, this serum was disappointing. I won't be purchasing it again and would recommend looking at other retinol options with better packaging and formulation.

I really like this retinol serum! I was expecting a milky, thin texture but it was actually a thicker serum that went on so smoothly and absorbed quickly. It is supposed to contain spicules, but I can't say I have felt any tingling associated with that ingredient. I did not experience any dry or flaking skin as a result of using this serum. Overall, I will continue to incorporate it into my routine and I'd recommend it for anyone who is a beginner to retinols.
I enjoy this product so far! It feels really nice on my skin and didnt irritate it so far. I'm excited to see the results after a few weeks
Easy to use an absorbs nicely into skin. I've only been using a few few weeks results have been subtle, but I'm excited to see long-term results after using it more.

avis.titre: Effective but not a great experience
avis.texte: This ampoule has been effective at brightening my skin and giving it an overall more youthful and healthy appearance, however it leaves a bit of a tacky residue and pills easily. The glass dropper bottle design looks very nice but the short dropper makes it difficult to get enough product out.

OK, so I really like this for the first couple of nights that I tried it, it made my skin feel really nice and it absorbed beautifully into my skin and it didn't dry my skin out which I loved. However, it did break me out.

avis.titre: Gentle retinol serum that leaves skin smooth and glowing
avis.texte: I've really enjoyed using this ampoule as part of my evening skincare routine. It absorbs quickly, feels lightweight, and doesn't leave my skin sticky or greasy. The combination of Centella and retinol helps my skin feel smoother, and I've noticed a brighter, more even-looking complexion with continued use. It layers well with moisturizer and hasn't caused irritation when used a few nights a week. A little goes a long way, making the bottle last. Overall, it's a great option if you're looking for a beginner-friendly retinol serum that delivers noticeable results.
I have been using this for a week in my daily routine and it's so gentle for my skin! I was afraid to add retinol in as my face is going through a journey but this is so refreshing and light and dewy

I have been using this product for three weeks now. I have sensitive skin so I started out using this serum 2x per week and increased to 3x per week. My skin has never looked better it is more even and radiance and my mild acne has cleared up. I will be purchasing again!

avis.titre: Would absolutely buy again and again
avis.texte: I've been using this retinol for a couple of weeks and I really like it. First, it's gentle. There wasn't weeks of my skin having to get used to it. Second, my skin didn't peel, get red, or "angry," like it has with other retinols. I use it at night, under my regular moisturizer, and in the morning my skin is glowing! There is no scent, it goes a long way making it a great value, and within like a week, my skin looked firmer, clearer, and more glowey. I highly recommend! Thank you Lab in Nature for the free Centella Retinol 0.2 Boosting Shot Ampoule 30ml.

I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review. So far I've really been enjoying this facial ampoule. It absorbs into my skin almost instantly. I have noticed it has smooth out my skin ever since I started using it.
Gave this a try when my old retinol ran out. It does the job, the formula is nice. I dont necessarily know that I'd rebuy, but i was willing to buy it first because of the brand.

I don't have sensitive skin and I can't say I react negatively to products often at all, but this one turned out to be a big problem. Dry patches all around and after about a month my regular products began to sting on application - that's what this product did to my skin barrier. Yes, I've used retinoids before and I did introduce it gradually, working my way up to a more frequent use. How do I know this is the issue? I stopped using it and 5 days later my skin was back to normal. Way too aggressive of a formula, particularly the Hydrolyzed Sponge (Spicules) "delivery method" in it that basically feels like tiny shards of glass cutting your skin when you apply it. Not to mention the dropper isn't great either. Definitely one of the worst skin care products I've ever used.

This has retinol and retinal (can't remember the exact % of retinal, but it was on the box). No skin irritation, but I've been using 0.3% retinol before this, so it could be potentially irritating for beginners. I'm looking to transition to using Retinal, and this has been great so far. It does have a gritty feel when applying. That doesn't bother me, but my skin is not that sensitive. One nuisance for me is the dropper. The way it wad designed with the bottle makes it hard to fill the dropper. I find that I have to angle the dropper and bottle in order for it to properly fill.
